newsitem.title: USA: United Refining Co sells $200 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: United Refining Co sells $200 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: The following 144a private placement of $200 million in high-yield debt from United Refining Co was priced on Wednesday via Dillon Read & Co Inc, market sources said.
The deal was increased from an original size of $175 million due to strong market demand, market sources said.
United Refining is a Warren, Pennsylvania-based oil refining company, they added.
